integrationFixes.defect: The talent rule records its bonus as manaGainedPct, but the Life Tap compiler reads manaGainPct, so the +10/20% mana award never reached combat.

integrationFixes.name: Resource overflow check (exposed by the Improved Life Tap fix)
integrationFixes.defect: With a fractional mana award (424 x 1.1) on a large pool, overflow computed as (current + gain) - max exceeded the gain by floating-point rounding and resourceThroughput rejected the event as invalid.
integrationFixes.fix: combat-statistics.mjs accepts overflow within 1e-9 relative of the gain and clamps it to the gain; genuinely larger overflow is still rejected.
